name: marq-toolbox
description: Everyday utilities for working with an AI agent at Marq: digest long output, confirm intent, zoom out and reframe, message coworkers on Slack, codify workflows, and connect Google Workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Everyday AI skills for every Marq employee
interface.longDescription: A general-purpose collection of AI skills for working with an agent at Marq: consolidate long output into a digest, confirm intent before acting, zoom out and reframe a problem, message coworkers on Slack, turn repeatable processes into skills, and connect Google Workspace.
defaultPrompt: Use $tldr to consolidate what you just told me into a short numbered digest.
Use $confirm to restate what I'm trying to accomplish before doing anything.
Use $slack to DM a coworker a summary of what we just did.
